attacks.name: Smash
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Throw|: After this attack is resolved, if the target character is Size 4 or less, this character may Throw the target character |!range_small|.

attacks.name: Gamma Burst
steps: Before |!damage| is dealt, this character may Throw the target character |!range_small|.
The target character does not gain |!power| for |!damage| dealt by this attack.

superPowers.name: Gamma Leap
superPowers.body: Place this character within |!range| 2 of its current position. This superpower can be used only once per turn.

superPowers.name: Leave Hulk ALONE!!!
superPowers.body: Choose an interactive terrain feature or an enemy character, both of Size 4 or less and within |!range| 2, and Throw it |!range_medium|. This superpower can be used only once per turn.

superPowers.name: Endless Rage
superPowers.body: During the |*Power Phase|, this character gains 2 additional |!power|.

superPowers.name: Immortality
superPowers.body: During the |*Cleanup Phase|, if this character has a Dazed token and an |<immortality>Immortality| token, it is KO'd.|\|Otherwise, during the |*Cleanup Phase|, while this character is Dazed, if this character does not have an Immortality token, it removes all special conditions and all |!power| from itself. For each |!power| removed this way, it removes 1 |!damage| from itself. It then removes its Dazed token and gains an Immortality token.

superPowers.name: The Green Door
superPowers.body: |*At the end of each turn|, if this character has an |<immortality>Immortality| token, it may remove 1 |!damage| from itself. If this character ever has no |!damage|, it removes its Immortality token.
